VIL-001.explanation: SELL is recommended: Buyer offer of INR 2250.00/t yields net revenue of INR 1254.00/t after deducting INR 996.00/t collection costs. This exceeds the best on-farm alternative by INR 384.00/t.

VIL-002.explanation: FEED is recommended: Local fodder net return of INR 1770.00/t outperforms retention/mulching (INR 438.25/t) and selling net return (INR 516.00/t).

VIL-003.explanation: KEEP is recommended: On-farm soil nutrient & moisture retention yields net agronomic value of INR 438.25/t (gross nutrient/carbon value INR 958.25/t minus INR 520.00/t incorporation cost). Current buyer offer gives only net INR -32.50/t (break-even is INR 1670.75/t).
